name: junction
description: Junction: a walk-around 3D rail game across Europe with online multiplayer on Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects.

scripts.build:3d: python3 tools3d/build.py junction.html tools3d/junction3d.template.html junction3d.html && python3 tools3d/make_saboteur_template.py && python3 tools3d/build.py junction-saboteur.html tools3d/junction3d-saboteur.template.html junction3d-saboteur.html
scripts.sim: node mp/build.mjs --engine && node mp/sim.mjs 200 blitz 1 && node mp/sim.mjs 200 classic 1 && node mp/timeout-check.mjs
scripts.dev:fast: npm run build && wrangler dev --var BOT_PACE:0.15
